description: Results of 966306 power flow simulations on the standard IEEE 123 Node Test Feeder is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Miroslav Blagojevic (The University of Newcastle Australia). A number of disruptive technologies are expected to impact on future power systems (PS). Electric vehicles (EV), photovoltaic systems (PV), wind turbines (WT), energy storage systems (ESS), vehicle to grid (V2G), and demand response (DR) are seen as those with the most significant potential impact on the PS. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
